# Model specification: sdmmc 1.0.0

SD/MMC host controller with one SD card, as used by PX4 and ArduPilot for parameters, logs and missions (4-bit bus, block transfers by DMA).

## Features

| Feature | Meaning |
|---|---|
| base | Commands, responses, block data path, flags and interrupt. |
| fifo_dma | Data through a FIFO served by an external DMA stream (STM32F7 SDMMC v1). |
| internal_dma | Data moved by the controller's internal DMA (STM32H7 SDMMC v2). |

## Terms

| Term | Kind | Feature | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| power_on | control | base | The card interface is powered. |
| clock_enable | control | base | The card clock runs (with divider, bus width: stored, enters timing only). |
| command_index | control | base | Command number to send. |
| command_argument | control | base | Command argument. |
| response_type | control | base | None, short or long response expected. |
| send_command | control | base | Starts the command. |
| response | status | base | Response words of the last command. |
| command_sent | status | base | A command without response has been sent. |
| response_received | status | base | A response arrived (CRC ok). |
| command_timeout | status | base | No response (e.g. no card, unsupported command). |
| data_length | control | base | Bytes in the data transfer. |
| block_size | control | base | Block size (512 for SD data). |
| data_direction | control | base | Card to host or host to card. |
| data_enable | control | base | Arms or starts the data path. |
| data_end | status | base | data_length bytes transferred. |
| data_block_end | status | base | A block transferred. |
| data_timeout | status | base | Data did not arrive in time. |
| flag_ack | ack | base | Clears the static flags (write 1 to clear). |
| irq_enables | control | base | Per-flag interrupt enables. |
| irq | event | base | Controller interrupt line (Devicetree interrupts). |
| fifo_data | data | fifo_dma | FIFO port read/written by an external DMA stream (dmas). |
| dma_request | event | fifo_dma | Request to the external DMA stream. |
| idma_base | control | internal_dma | Buffer address for the controller's own DMA. |
| idma_enable | control | internal_dma | The controller moves data itself. |

## Behaviour rules

| Rule | Feature | Rule text |
|---|---|---|
| ADV-SDMMC-B001 | base | send_command with power_on and clock_enable delivers command_index and command_argument to the card; the card's answer appears in response and response_received turns on, or command_sent for commands without response, or command_timeout when the card does not answer (ADV-SD-001). |
| ADV-SDMMC-B002 | base | A data transfer moves data_length bytes in blocks of block_size in data_direction, block by block in order; data_block_end turns on after each block and data_end after the last (ADV-SD-002, ADV-SD-003). |
| ADV-SDMMC-B003 | fifo_dma | Data passes through fifo_data; dma_request is raised while the FIFO can take or give a burst, so the external DMA stream moves the data. |
| ADV-SDMMC-B004 | internal_dma | With idma_enable, the controller reads or writes memory at idma_base itself. |
| ADV-SDMMC-B005 | base | irq is raised while a flag is on whose enable in irq_enables is on; flag_ack clears flags. |
| ADV-SDMMC-B006 | base | The card content comes from the host image named in the configuration and persists across runs only through that image. |

**Timing.** Command and data completion clocks follow the bus clock and bus width; the timing rules of docs/device-tree-design.md apply.

**Out of scope.** MMC/eMMC/SDIO cards, UHS speeds and voltage switching, boot mode, read wait, card detect/write protect pins other than as stored
